# Marinated greens

Type: Food | Internal ID: MarinatedGreens | Source: Cauldron | Usage: Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Sap x3, Magecap x2, Fiddlehead x2, Smoke puff x2 | Max Health: 32 | Max Stamina: 16 | Max Eitr: 95 | Duration: 30m | Healing: 4 hp/tick

# Introduction

Marinated greens are an Ashlands-tier food.

## Recipe

Marinated greens are produced in a level 6 Cauldron with:
• 3 Sap
• 2 Magecap
• 2 Fiddlehead
• 2 Smoke puff

## Notes

• Marinated greens provides the highest eitr gain in the game at 95.
